title: Lagged Federal Reserve bank-reserve growth liquidity support for BTC long or cash
thesis: A Wednesday-ending WRESBAL weekly average strictly above its value four observations earlier may identify an all-else-equal bank-reserve liquidity-support state with better subsequent BTC return and path-risk evidence than other weeks.
mechanism: Use only official Board H.4.1 RESH4R_XAW_N.WW observations equivalent to FRED WRESBAL, make each observation usable on Friday 00:00 UTC, compare it with the observation exactly four weeks earlier, and evaluate one non-overlapping 168-hour BTC response. The supportive state is strict reserve-balance growth; no threshold, smoothing, alternate lag, direction inversion or combined macro factor is allowed.
economic_rationale: If and only if both Design and Validation establish the preregistered predictive direction, a later matched-capital policy would hold full BTC during supportive weeks and zero-yield cash otherwise. It must improve fee-adjusted Calmar and underwater duration while explicitly charging turnover, lost upside and capital utilization.
